subject: reasoning
question: X and Y are brothers. Z is the wife of Y. A is the father of X. B is the daughter of Z. How is B related to A?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Given: 

X and Y are brothers → They are sons of A.
Z is the wife of Y.
B is the daughter of Z → Since Z is Y’s wife, B is the daughter of Y and Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5155dc46556cec9e9915ffad5d289b3317e55ecc6061ae9097a872b4248f9fe6.png] 

So, B is the **granddaughter of A**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
